newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds frozen as canals remain blocked.
newsitem.headline: European feeds frozen as canals remain blocked.

text.p: European feeds trading remained in a frozen state on Thursday as sub-zero temperatures continued across northern Europe, blocking small inland waterways and causing logistical problems for consumers.
"Everybody is wrapped up with sorting out how to get the products they've already bought through to the factories. There's very little fresh business being done," one trader said.
There were no soymeal or sunmeal trades reported.
German traders said the river Rhine was still largely unaffected but with temperatures set to drop again tonight, some thought a partial blockage was inevitable soon.
